title: Quiz 3 — spin groups, magnons (collinear and non-collinear) & finite-T hulls

questions.question: How many collinear spin space groups are there (non-trivial parts)?
questions.explanation: They map one-to-one onto the black-and-white magnetic groups of type I, III and IV: 230 + 674 + 517 = 1421.

questions.question: SymPhase labels a collinear SSG by the BNS number of a magnetic group. Which replacement defines that group?
questions.explanation: Every element that flips the spins, [C2⊥||g], becomes the primed operation gT; spin-preserving ones stay unprimed.

questions.question: The spin-only group of a collinear magnet is …
questions.explanation: All rotations about the spin axis plus C2⊥ combined with T leave a collinear configuration invariant.

questions.question: Why is the anomalous Hall effect of a collinear magnet forbidden without SOC?

options.b: the spin-only element [C2⊥T || E] acts on σ_ij as pure time reversal

questions.explanation: [C2⊥T||E] leaves the lattice untouched but contains T, so every T-odd charge response vanishes; SOC is required.

questions.question: In a collinear magnet without SOC every magnon carries …
questions.explanation: S_z is conserved, so each mode lowers (α) or raises (β) the total S_z by one.

questions.question: The symmetry of the magnon chirality splitting Δω(q) in an altermagnet is …

options.b: the same as the electronic NR spin splitting s(k) (d, g or i-wave)

questions.explanation: Both are fixed by the same spin group: RuO2 is d-wave for electrons and magnons.

questions.question: Which exchange paths split the magnon chiralities in RuO2?

options.c: the same-sublattice 6.35 Å bonds along [110] and [1-10], which are inequivalent

questions.explanation: Crystal symmetry (O positions) makes the [110] and [1-10] bonds of one sublattice different and swaps them on the other: J7 ≠ J8 gives Δω ∝ qx·qy.

questions.question: Hands-on: how many symmetry classes of Ru–Ru bonds does SymPhase find in RuO2 up to 6.5 Å?
questions.explanation: J1 … J8; the last two have identical length 6.35 Å but are not related by any crystal operation.

questions.question: Hands-on: BNS number labelling the collinear spin space group of MnTe (examples/vasp/MnTe_altermagnet_INCAR)?
questions.explanation: P6_3'/m'mc' (194.269), consistent with the spin Laue group ²6/²m¹m²m.

questions.question: Why is there no magnon chirality splitting in bcc Cr (AFM with opposite spins at (0,0,0) and (½,½,½))?

options.b: the sublattices are connected by a translation [C2⊥||τ]

questions.explanation: [C2⊥||τ] maps α onto β at the same q, so both chiralities are degenerate everywhere (as for electrons).

questions.question: Why does non-collinear LSWT use a local frame (u_i, v_i) for every spin?

options.b: Holstein–Primakoff bosons describe deviations from each spin's own direction v_i
options.d: it is only a plotting convention

questions.explanation: The bosons live in the plane ⊥ v_i (u_i = x_i + i y_i); the global spectrum is independent of the in-plane choice of x_i.

questions.question: Hands-on: how many zero-energy (Goldstone) modes does the 120° triangular antiferromagnet have at Γ of its 3-sublattice cell?
questions.explanation: ω(k), ω(k+K), ω(k−K) all vanish at k = 0: the three generators of SO(3) are all broken by the coplanar order.

questions.question: Which formula is the LSWT dispersion of the nearest-neighbour 120° triangular Heisenberg AFM (γ_k = Σ cos(k·δ)/3)?
questions.explanation: SymPhase reproduces it to 10⁻⁴ meV (tutorial 6 and the tests).

questions.question: Hands-on: canted chain with J = 1 meV and staggered D = 0.2 meV: by how many degrees are the spins canted away from antiparallel after --relax?
questions.explanation: φ = arctan(D/J) = 11.31°; the canting gives a weak ferromagnetic moment ⊥ to the Néel vector.

questions.question: To obtain a canted (weak-ferromagnetic) state rather than a spiral in a two-sublattice chain, the DM vectors must be …

options.a: uniform along the chain (same D for every i → i+1 bond)
options.b: staggered, so that D·(S_A × S_B) has the same sign on both bonds

questions.explanation: A uniform D twists every bond the same way (spiral); the staggered pattern of J_DM.dat favours one fixed canting angle.

questions.question: Hands-on: which non-relativistic spin-splitting form does SymPhase find for the coplanar 120° triangular antiferromagnet?
questions.explanation: The coplanar spin-only element C2(n)T forces s_z(−k) = −s_z(k); the lowest allowed form is cubic (f-wave), s_z ∝ kx(kx² − 3ky²).

questions.question: Configurational entropy (k_B per atom) of a high-entropy half-Heusler with sublattices 'TiZrHf | Ni | Sn'?
questions.explanation: −(3 · ⅓ ln ⅓)/3 = ln 3 / 3 = 0.366 k_B per atom.

questions.question: Hands-on: mixing entropy only (vib='none'): temperature at which (Ti0.5Zr0.5)NiSn (E_hull = 5 meV/atom) reaches the hull?
questions.explanation: k_B T ln2 / 3 = 5 meV → T* = 251 K.

questions.question: Debye model: zero-point vibrational energy per atom for θ_D = 400 K, in meV/atom?
Which statement about vib='bartel' is correct?

options.b: it uses the SISSO descriptor of Bartel et al. via pymatgen, needs structures, valid 300–2000 K

questions.explanation: GibbsComputedStructureEntry estimates G(T) from volume and mass; mixing entropy is still added on top.
